description: This source file contains functions related to handling Git tags, including verification, dereferencing, lookup, parsing, and memory management for tag objects within a Git repository. It also includes GPG verification for tags.

methods.name: int run_gpg_verify(const char * buf,unsigned long size,unsigned flags)
methods.description: Performs GPG verification of a given buffer containing a signature, with verbosity controlled by flags.

methods.name: int gpg_verify_tag(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * oid,const char * name_to_report,unsigned flags)
methods.description: Verifies the signature of a tag object within a repository using GPG.

methods.name: struct:object * deref_tag(struct repository * r,struct object * o,const char * warn,int warnlen)
methods.description: Dereferences a tag object to the object it points to, optionally warning if the reference is missing.

methods.name: struct:tag * lookup_tag(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Looks up a tag object by its object ID, creating it if it does not exist.

methods.name: timestamp_t parse_tag_date(const char * buf,const char * tail)
methods.description: Parses a date from a tag annotation string.

methods.name: void release_tag_memory(struct tag * t)
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a tag object.

methods.name: int parse_tag_buffer(struct repository * r,struct tag * item,const void * data,unsigned long size)
methods.description: Parses the buffer of a tag object to extract relevant information and populate a tag structure.

methods.name: int parse_tag(struct repository * r,struct tag * item)
methods.description: Reads and parses a tag object from the repository, validating its type.

methods.name: struct:object_id * get_tagged_oid(struct tag * tag)
methods.description: Retrieves the OID of the object tagged by a tag object.

ctags.name: deref_tag
ctags.pattern: /^struct object *deref_tag(struct repository *r, struct object *o, const char *warn, int warnlen)$/
ctags.signature: (struct repository * r,struct object * o,const char * warn,int warnlen)

ctags.signature: (struct repository * r,const struct object_id * oid,const char * name_to_report,unsigned flags)

ctags.name: parse_tag_buffer
ctags.pattern: /^int parse_tag_buffer(struct repository *r, struct tag *item, const void *data, unsigned long siz/
ctags.signature: (struct repository * r,struct tag * item,const void * data,unsigned long size)

ctags.pattern: /^static int run_gpg_verify(const char *buf, unsigned long size, unsigned flags)$/
